name: duology
description: Claude Code plugins for designing, building, testing and shipping apps on iPhone Duo, the foldable iPhone with an outer and an inner display. Community project, not affiliated with Apple.

plugins.name: duology
plugins.description: Foundation for iPhone Duo apps: Xcode 27.1 and simulator setup, layout across the fold, vertical bars, and state that survives fold and unfold. Adds /duo-doctor.

plugins.name: duology-design
plugins.description: Design for iPhone Duo: eight layout patterns, two people on one screen, and a 15-point review of screenshots and Figma frames.

plugins.name: duology-recipes
plugins.description: App recipes for iPhone Duo. /duo-new creates a project that builds and runs on the iPhone Duo simulator. v0.1 has one recipe: a two-player game.

plugins.name: duology-ship
plugins.description: Test and ship for iPhone Duo: duo-lint (the fold linter), an opt-in lint hook, tests on the Duo simulator, and /duo-audit.
